universities.name: Xi'an Jiaotong University
universities.overview: Xi'an Jiaotong University in Shaanxi is a public research university founded in 1896 and a member of the C9 League. Its 2027 Xi'an study options below cover Chinese-language learning and Chinese-taught foundation pathways. Each option has its own entry conditions, length and fee basis, so select the route that matches your academic and language preparation.

programs.name: Chinese Language Programme - Spring semester
qualifications: Above 18 and below 45 years old.
In good health.
Hold a valid ordinary foreign passport.
languageRequirements: A placement test is held before classes; students are assigned to elementary, intermediate or advanced classes.
The brochure does not specify a minimum entry HSK score.
documents: Valid ordinary foreign passport.
Confirm the complete upload checklist for this language programme with the admissions office; the brochure does not provide a detailed document list.

fees.notes: Published price for one semester.
Use the scholarship application fee instead if applying through a scholarship route; do not add both fees.
Alternative to the CNY 500 self-funded application fee; scholarship eligibility and award are assessed separately.
On-campus accommodation is required in principle. The room, campus and accommodation fee must be confirmed before payment.
Insurance must be purchased under university rules; the brochure does not state its price.
The brochure does not quote a deposit amount or payment schedule; confirm the written offer.

notes: 18-22 contact hours each week, with comprehensive Chinese, listening and speaking, reading and writing, and HSK preparation.
Electives may include calligraphy, painting, business Chinese, poetry, literature, linguistics and cultural activities; availability depends on class arrangements.
A transcript and completion certificate are issued after successful completion. This is a non-degree language programme.
Applications may close early when the class quota is filled. The admission letter confirms the exact start date.
International Chinese Language Teachers Scholarship applications are possible; eligibility, coverage and selection require separate assessment and no award is guaranteed.
Accommodation, insurance, medical examination, residence permit and any additional costs must be confirmed individually. No all-inclusive price is quoted.
The brochure refers to a separate university refund policy. Confirm the applicable refund conditions in writing before paying.
programs.progression: A language completion certificate is not a bachelor admission offer. Any subsequent degree application is assessed separately.

programs.name: International Foundation Programme - Basic
qualifications: Applicants below 24 in good health; the university must confirm eligibility at age 24 because the Chinese and English age wording differs.
Valid ordinary foreign passport.
High-school/senior-secondary diploma or equivalent; graduating students may apply with mock-examination results.
High-school average of at least 60% for the International Foundation Programme.
Guardian authorisation is required below age 18.
languageRequirements: No prior Chinese-language requirement is specified for the Basic route.
documents: Scanned copy of a valid ordinary foreign passport.
High-school or equivalent graduation diploma, with original and notarised copies in Chinese or English. Graduating students may apply using mock-examination results.
High-school transcripts covering all subjects and university entrance examination results, including original and notarised copies.
Chinese-language proficiency certificate such as HSK or HSKK when required. A native Chinese speaker may receive an exemption only after university approval.
One recommendation letter from a high-school headmaster or teacher, signed and including the referee’s email address and phone number.
Study plan in Chinese or English, at least 600 Chinese characters or 600 English words.

Foreigner Physical Examination Record in Chinese or English, with all examinations, a photograph and stamp, doctor’s opinion/signature and hospital seal. The Chinese brochure states a six-month validity and original/notarised copies.
Non-criminal record certificate with its validity/expiry stated.
Guardian authorisation for an applicant below 18.
Other supporting materials, if available.

fees.notes: Full 36-week foundation tuition; the published rate is the same for humanities/business/social science and science/engineering. Undergraduate tuition is not included.
Pay after passing the initial review. Non-refundable regardless of the admission result.

notes: Application window: 1 November 2026 - 15 July 2027.
Study directions: humanities (business and social science) or science and engineering. Classes are grouped by language level and intended subject.
